title: Eera Nilam
desc: A woman's sons go to the Kargil war and get martyred. Later, the younger son takes the responsibility of supporting his family.

title: Sarigamapadani
desc: Kulasekaran, a Casanova, tries to seduce Sangita, but his actions push her away. Later, he falls in love with Archana but is unaware of her real identity.

title: Chithiram Pesuthadi
desc: Thiru, a local gangster, changes his wayward ways after falling in love with an NGO worker. However, his path toward redemption is jeopardised after the police arrest him for his past crimes.

title: Kozhi Koovuthu
desc: Velusamy, a jobless man, desires to marry his niece Kamatchi. He joins the army to earn a living so that he can marry her. Meanwhile, Kamatchi falls in love with Ramakrishnan, the village postman.

title: Vallal
desc: Durairasu is heartbroken when the girl he loves marries another man. However, when the girl and her husband die in an accident, Durairasu dedicates his life to bringing up their daughter.
